title: Fine-Grained Data Ordering Improves Fine-Tuning for Large Language Models
authors_zh: Xiaomeng Hu, Yixuan Tang, Haoze Li, Hao Chen, Qi Zhang, Zhanming Shen, Yiming Zhang, Haobo Wang, Junbo Zhao
paper_type_zh: 细粒度训练数据调度研究
best_for_zh: 为持续预训练或监督微调设计课程顺序、但不希望丢弃样本的读者。
one_line: FOT scores examples by model-relative difficulty, trains easy-to-hard in the first epoch, and restores random order thereafter.
FOT 按模型相对难度为样本打分，在第一轮按由易到难训练，之后恢复随机顺序。
why: It shows that the order in which data is consumed is itself a training decision, distinct from filtering or mixing the data beforehand.
inclusion_reason: It changes the order in which every retained training example is consumed, using model-relative difficulty rather than a static preprocessing subset.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Data-centric fine-tuning usually decides what to remove before training starts, then presents the surviving data in a random order. That practice overlooks a separate decision: the sequence of gradient updates determines how a pre-trained model moves from its original distribution toward a specialized target distribution. Random shuffling may force abrupt alternation between familiar and difficult examples even when all examples are relevant.

The paper asks whether every retained example can be used more effectively by changing when it is consumed rather than whether it is kept. It proposes an easy-to-hard first pass based on the relationship between a sample and the current pre-trained model, followed by ordinary random-order training. The goal is a smooth adaptation path that retains the full dataset rather than treating data governance only as cleaning or selection.

以数据为中心的微调通常在训练开始前决定删除什么，然后以随机顺序呈现剩余数据。这种做法忽略了另一个独立决策：梯度更新的序列决定了预训练模型如何从原有分布移向专门的目标分布。即使所有样本都相关，随机打乱也可能让模型在熟悉样本与困难样本之间突然交替。

论文要回答的是：能否通过改变每个保留样本被消费的时机，而不是改变它是否被保留，来更有效地利用全部样本。它提出依据样本与当前预训练模型之间关系进行由易到难的第一轮训练，随后恢复普通的随机顺序训练。目标是在保留完整数据集的同时形成平滑的适应路径，而不是只把数据治理理解为清洗或选择。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
FOT treats difficulty as model-relative rather than as a fixed property such as length or topic. A sample is harder when the base model assigns it higher cross-entropy loss and when its token pattern appears less covered by the estimated pre-training distribution. Sorting the full training set by this joint score approximates a curriculum that starts near the base model's familiar distribution and gradually moves toward the target domain.

The curriculum is deliberately temporary. The first epoch uses easy-to-hard ordering, with random shuffling only inside contiguous score blocks; later epochs randomly shuffle the whole dataset to avoid overfitting to one sequence. Thus the proposal does not replace training data or add a teacher label. It changes the consumer schedule of the same records and argues that early ordering prepares the model for later difficult updates while later randomness preserves ordinary optimization behavior.

FOT 将难度视为相对于模型的量，而不是长度或主题等固定属性。当基础模型给一个样本分配更高的交叉熵损失，且该样本的词元模式在估计的预训练分布中看起来覆盖更少时，该样本就更困难。按这一联合分数对完整训练集排序，近似得到一条课程：从接近基础模型熟悉分布的样本开始，逐渐移向目标领域。

这套课程被刻意设计为暂时的。第一轮训练使用由易到难的顺序，但只在相邻分数块内部随机打乱；后续轮次随机打乱整个数据集，以避免对某一个序列过拟合。因此，该方案既不替换训练数据，也不添加教师标签。它改变的是同一批记录的消费调度，并认为早期排序为之后的困难更新做好准备，而后期随机性则保留了常规优化行为。

title: Method
方法
html:
For each example, FOT computes cross-entropy under the pre-trained model and an estimated pre-training-distribution component. Because the original pre-training corpus is unavailable, the latter is approximated with RedPajama token frequencies following a prior detection method. A weighted average of the two quantities gives the difficulty score. All data are ranked from simple to difficult; no record is filtered out, relabeled, or regenerated.

Training has two phases. In the first of two reported epochs, the sorted list is divided into blocks and shuffled only within each block, preserving a global easy-to-hard progression while keeping some local stochasticity. In the second epoch, the whole dataset is randomly shuffled. The paper applies this same schedule to a two-billion-token code/general continued-pretraining mixture and to MathInstruct and Magicoder supervised fine-tuning, then compares it with random, reverse, mixed, and alternative curriculum orders.

对每个样本，FOT 计算其在预训练模型下的交叉熵，以及一个估计的预训练分布成分。由于原始预训练语料不可获得，后者遵循既有检测方法，用 RedPajama 的词元频率近似。两个量的加权平均给出难度分数。所有数据从简单到困难排序；没有记录会被过滤、重新标注或重新生成。

训练分为两个阶段。在文中报告的两轮训练中的第一轮，排序列表被划分为若干块，只在块内打乱，从而在保留整体由易到难推进的同时维持局部随机性。第二轮中，整个数据集被随机打乱。论文将同一调度应用于一个二十亿词元的代码、通用语料混合持续预训练，以及 MathInstruct 和 Magicoder 监督微调，并将其与随机、逆序、混合和其他课程顺序比较。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
For continued pre-training of Llama-3.2-1B, FOT obtains a 22.39 average over general and code benchmarks, compared with 20.96 under random order, a gain of 1.43 points. In supervised fine-tuning, the reported average gains over random order are 1.74 points for Llama-3.2-1B, 1.69 for Llama-3.1-8B, 4.34 for Gemma-3-4B, and 1.60 for Qwen-3-4B across math and code benchmarks. The paper summarizes an average improvement of 2.4 percent across its experiments.

The ablations also support the two-phase decision. For Llama-3.1-8B, using only the curriculum phase lowers the average from 49.01 to 40.99, whereas curriculum followed by random order reaches 50.70. Reverse curricula and mixed easy-hard batches fail to match the result consistently. These comparisons indicate that the measured effect is not simply a benefit of sorting once: it depends on the model-relative difficulty definition and on returning to unconstrained random exposure after the initial transition.

对于 Llama-3.2-1B 的持续预训练，FOT 在通用和代码基准上的平均分为 22.39，而随机顺序为 20.96，提升 1.43 分。在监督微调中，文中报告的相对于随机顺序的平均提升分别为：Llama-3.2-1B 提升 1.74 分、Llama-3.1-8B 提升 1.69 分、Gemma-3-4B 提升 4.34 分、Qwen-3-4B 提升 1.60 分，覆盖数学和代码基准。论文概述其全部实验的平均提升为 2.4%。

消融实验也支持两阶段决策。对于 Llama-3.1-8B，只使用课程阶段会使平均分从 49.01 降至 40.99，而先课程后随机顺序达到 50.70。逆序课程和混合简单、困难批次都未能稳定达到这一结果。这些比较表明，测得的效果不只是一次排序带来的收益：它依赖于相对于模型的难度定义，并且依赖于在初始过渡后重新回到无约束的随机曝光。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The contribution is to make order a first-class property of a training record. Filtering asks whether an example may enter the corpus; mixing asks how many examples of each source are present. FOT instead attaches a difficulty rank to every retained example and specifies when it is consumed. The method therefore changes the optimization trajectory without reducing the data budget or introducing a new synthetic supervision source.

Its second distinctive choice is the hybrid schedule. A pure easy-to-hard curriculum is not presented as universally better; the authors show that retaining it alone can sharply harm an 8B model. The proposed first-epoch curriculum and later random phase make the training consumer adaptive in time while preserving the diversity of updates. This offers a specific, testable alternative to the assumption that random shuffling is a neutral default for all fine-tuning data.

该工作的贡献是让顺序成为训练记录的一等属性。过滤关注一个样本能否进入语料；混合关注每个来源包含多少样本。FOT 则为每一个保留样本附加难度排名，并规定它何时被消费。因此，该方法在不减少数据预算、也不引入新的合成监督来源的情况下改变优化轨迹。

第二个独特选择是混合调度。纯粹的由易到难课程并未被描述成普遍更好；作者表明，只保留这一课程会明显损害一个 8B 模型。所提出的第一轮课程和后续随机阶段，使训练消费者随时间发生适应，同时保留更新的多样性。这为“随机打乱对所有微调数据都是中性默认值”的假设提供了一个具体且可检验的替代方案。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The original pre-training distribution is unavailable and is replaced by RedPajama frequencies, so the coverage component is only an approximation and may vary for models with different hidden corpora. The experiments span models from 1B to 8B parameters and two training epochs, with no larger-scale test and no official implementation or ordered-data release. The authors also state that the intuitive mechanism behind the effect needs deeper analysis; the observed gains do not by themselves prove why a particular rank improves a particular model.
原始预训练分布不可获得，只能以 RedPajama 频率替代，因此覆盖度成分只是近似，对于隐藏语料不同的模型可能发生变化。实验覆盖 1B 到 8B 参数的模型和两轮训练，没有更大规模测试，也没有官方实现或排序数据发布。作者还指出，该效果背后的直观机制需要更深入分析；观察到的提升本身不能证明为什么某个特定排名能改善某个特定模型。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: This paper is useful when every example is judged worth retaining but teams need a principled way to stage exposure during fine-tuning. It supplies a record-level score, a schedule boundary, and ablations that separate temporary curriculum use from permanent sorting. Before adoption, reproduce the scoring pass on the intended base model, verify the legality and representativeness of the corpus used to approximate pre-training coverage, and measure whether the proposed order remains beneficial under the actual number of epochs and optimizer settings.
当每个样本都被认为值得保留，但团队需要一种有原则的方式安排微调期间的样本曝光时，这篇论文很有用。它提供记录级分数、调度边界，以及将暂时使用课程与永久排序区分开的消融实验。在采用之前，应当在目标基础模型上复现评分过程，核验用于近似预训练覆盖度的语料是否合规且具有代表性，并测量所提顺序在实际训练轮数和优化器设置下是否仍然有益。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read Sections 3.3 and 3.4 before interpreting the benchmark tables: the card's key object is the difficulty score plus the two-phase consumption schedule, not a new dataset. Table 3 is especially important because it rules out the tempting but incorrect simplification that easy-to-hard order should be used throughout all epochs. For a reproduction plan, list the exact score normalizations, the block size, the curriculum-to-random switch point, and the proxy corpus used for pre-training coverage; those choices determine the actual training records seen early by the model.
在解读基准表格之前，应先读第 3.3 节和第 3.4 节：本卡的关键对象是难度分数加上两阶段消费调度，而不是一个新数据集。表 3 尤其重要，因为它排除了一个看似诱人却错误的简化，即在所有训练轮次中始终使用由易到难顺序。若制定复现实验计划，应列出精确的分数归一化、块大小、从课程到随机顺序的切换点，以及用于预训练覆盖度的代理语料；这些选择决定模型早期实际看到哪些训练记录。
